index.summary: Implementation Tasks for the XPath core Iteration.

task.title: Define the Iteration-first layout
task.objective: Remove the mandatory project catalog and make date-prefixed Iteration directories the first project discovery surface.
task.rationale: A new Agent should understand available work through one directory listing.

constraints.constraint: Iteration discovery must not depend on project.xml.

acceptance.criterion: A directory listing shows the Iteration and special project content.
The Iteration ID equals its directory name.

context.summary: The .dogdouspec directory is the implicit project boundary. Research is represented as another Iteration directory with kind="research".

record.summary: Use fixed filenames inside each Iteration and no mandatory catalog.
The Iteration-first demo layout was completed.

check.summary: No project.xml, goal.xml, evidence.xml, or transaction directory is present in the adjusted demo.

index.summary: Define variables and composable structural projection.

task.title: Define XPath projection
task.objective: Define XPath variables, ds:filter, ds:filter-out, and compact XML results so an Agent can inspect Task indexes without loading large Task content.
task.rationale: Standard XPath 1.0 can select source nodes but cannot return a projected copy with selected direct members retained or removed.

constraints.constraint: Projection must never modify managed source XML.
Members select only the current element's attributes and direct children.
A valid member absent from an input element is ignored.
Query limits fail explicitly and return no partial successful result.

acceptance.criterion: ds:filter retains only named direct attributes and child elements.
ds:filter-out removes only named direct attributes and child elements.
Projection results remain composable XPath node sets.

context.summary: The implementation uses XPath 1.0 with a custom XsltContext. IXsltContextVariable binds strings. IXsltContextFunction returns an XPathNodeIterator for structural projection. Standard composition after the function remains owned by System.Xml.XPath.
context.design_snapshot: The ds prefix is bound by the CLI. filter is an allow-list projection; filter-out is an exclusion projection. Both preserve the selected root.

record.summary: Return a complete projected node set and let .NET evaluate subsequent paths, predicates, unions, and nested extension calls.
The contract examples are drafted. Materialized versus virtual projection remains an implementation choice pending focused tests.

index.summary: Freeze integrated Task history and verification records.

task.title: Define Task-local execution history
task.objective: Define structured discussion, question, attempt, decision, blocker, handoff, verification, and completion records inside the owning context.
task.rationale: Ordinary verification does not need an independent Evidence lifecycle.

constraints.constraint: Git owns mechanical history; Task records own resumable semantic history.

acceptance.criterion: A completed Task carries its verification and completion provenance.
A discussion record preserves its trigger, material alternatives, rejection reasons, outcome, and remaining uncertainty.

context.summary: External artifacts are optional links from records. Signatures and hash chains are outside v1.

index.summary: Define template-first atomic updates for tasks.xml.

task.title: Define generic Task updates
task.objective: Define schema template discovery, append, Task update, expected revision, idempotency, validation, and atomic replacement while retaining a generic transaction fallback.
task.rationale: Most durable mutations append records. Templates keep XML visible while helpers remove repeated XPath, cardinality, timestamp, and operation-order mechanics from the normal Skill path.

constraints.constraint: Transaction request documents are not persisted project state.

acceptance.criterion: Attribute, acceptance, and record updates commit together or not at all.
A stale expected revision fails without changing tasks.xml.
An Agent can retrieve and fill a schema-valid append or Task update template without authoring a raw transaction.
Retrying an identical node or update ID cannot append duplicate history.

context.summary: The tasks.xml root revision provides optimistic concurrency. Append and Task update are the default mutation surface. The generic transaction is an escape hatch. No lease, task-claim file, or task-complete file is required in v1.
